statement: Pinned SDL Triton InitDevice/OpenJoystick for direct 1302 allocates context, identifies connected wired joystick and declares sensors/touchpads without reading a serial/attributes/IMU or trackpad calibration feature reply in those open methods. Its periodic feature1 lizard-disable 0x87 write can fail without aborting UpdateDevice, whereas explicit sensor-enable 0x87 SET returns false on short feature write; output 0x80 rumble is separately checked. This is bounded consumer open-path inspection, not proof that real devices lack calibration or every SDL/Steam client behaves this way. SDL 127-144,453-475,494-520,570-623,653-676.

applicability.revision: Valve udev 22ec85e5 / Linux v7.3-rc1 / SDL3 6defbc0 inspected; actual device revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: Direct 28de:1302 open path, other 2026 IDs only for conditional permission applicability; no host or physical evidence
